tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dge bshes dpal ldan shākya bstan 'dzin gyis dri lan gnad kyi gsal byed bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ 'gro ba'i blo mun sel mdzad pa/ /'jam dbyangs zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud/ /dogs sel dri ba'i 'phreng ba la/ /rang dang rjes mthun lan tsam brjod/ /dri ba dang po/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i dbang gi sngags sdom thob la ma nyams pa'i gang zag gis/ 'khor lo bde mchog lta bu'i dbang thob pa'i tshe/ sngags sdom gsar du thob rgyu ji ltar yod/ /ces pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ de'i tshe gsar thob ni yod de/ sngar bla med kyi sdom ldan la/ slob dpon gyis dbang bskur byas sam/ sdom ldan rang nyid kyis dbang blangs kyang rung ste/ sngar gyi sngags sdom gyi rgyun de nyid dbang bskur re re thob pa la brten nas/ lhag par 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir na/ ci tsam 'phel ba'i cha de/ de dang de las gsar du thob par 'gyur la/ 'phel ba de yang rgyun mi chad par 'jug go /'on kyang gang thob bya dbang gi ngo bo rigs mthun phyin chad du/ sdom par rigs mi 'dra med cing*/ dbang phyi ma phyi ma thob pa rnams la yang*/ snga ma'i sdom pa'i rgyun de nyid bzung zhing rgya che bar song ba ma gtogs/ sdom pa rigs 'dra zhing*/ ngo bo tha dad pa 'jug pa'ang med pas/ sdom pa dngos gzhi yongs rdzogs gsar thob ni med do/ /skabs 'dir 'di ltar shes dgos te/ dbang dang po de la ma smin pa smin par byed pa zhes bya zhing*/ phyi ma rnams la yang rang rang gi ngo skal gyi sngar ma smin pa smin par byas pa'i cha shas re yod mod kyang*/ smin tshul de tsam zhig ni sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du rtag tu 'byung bas/ phyi ma rnams la ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i tha snyad mi sbyor ro/ /yang sam pu ṭa'i rgyud phyi ma nas/ rig pa'i dbang gi skabs su gos kyi dbang zhes pa lhag por gsungs pa dang*/ mi g.yo ba bla med las ral gri zhags pa'i dbang sogs bshad pa dang*/ dus 'khor las dar dpyangs kyi dbang logs su gsungs shing*/ chu dbang sogs gzhan rnams kyang*/

sbyang gzhi sbyong byed spyi dang mi 'dra bar gsungs pa rnams la yang*/ phan tshun gcig gis gcig dod thub pa yin pas/ cho ga'i rnam grangs mi 'dra ba tsam dang*/ rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par tsam ma gtogs/ gtso bo'i don la mtshungs pa'i phyir/ de dag so so las thob pa'i sdom pa rnams kyang ngo bo gcig tu 'gyur bar shes par bya zhing*/ dus kyi 'khor lo rang lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la ni/ sdom pa'i rim pa gsar 'thob yod par shes dgos te/ slob dpon chen po'i gnas 'thob par byed pa'i dbang yin par yang yang bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dbang de ni ma thob kyang*/ dbang bcu gcig po thob pa'i slob dpon gyis/ slob ma la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba dang rgyud bshad pa'i tshe/ dbang dang rgyud bshad rnam dag gi go mi chod pa ni ma yin te/ dbang bzhi pa'i bar gyi mthar thug pa'i dbang rgyun yod pa'i phyir na/ rgyud sde gzhan gyi rigs 'grer rung bas so/ /'on kyang rgyud de nyid kyi lugs la/ de bzhin gshegs pas bkag pa las 'das pa'i nyes pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis bkas ma gnang ba'i nyes pa gnyis slob dpon rang la 'byung zhing*/ dbang de nyid kyi rgyun chad pa dang*/ de chad pas rgyud sde de'i dbang yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i nyes par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du kyai rdo rje'i dbang kho na thob pas 'dus pa dang bde mchog la sogs pa yang sgom du rung ba tsam ni yin zhing*/ 'on kyang so so'i bka' ma thob na/ slob dpon gyi bkas ma gnang ba'i nyes pa yod pas byin rlabs kyi sgo chung ba yin no/ /'o na dkyil 'khor gcig tu dbang thob pa kho nas sngags sdom dang ldan pa de la/ slob dpon gyis 'di sgoms shig ces pa'i tshig tsam gyis sgrub thabs man ngag gzhan thams cad la gnang ba byin pas chog gam snyam na/ de ltar mi chog ste/ de lta bu'i gnang ba sbyin pa de la'ang*/ sangs rgyas nas slob dpon gyi bar du gnang ba sbyin pa rgyun ma chad par dgos la/

gnang ba ster tshul ni ma nges te/ cho ga'i tshul gyis ster ba dang*/ lung 'bogs pa dang*/ glegs bam bklag pa la sogs pas kyang rung mod/ de yang lag len gyi rgyun ma chad pa'i srol de nyid bzang ba yin no/ /des na/ theg pa bla na med pa'i dbang bskur ba rdzogs pa gcig thob pa phyin chad/ dkyil 'khor de nyid dam dkyil 'khor gzhan gyi yang rung ste/ dbang bskur ba ci tsam mang ba de tsam bzang la/ yang so so mtha' dag la dbang bskur kho na thob mi dgos par/ tha dad kyi byin brlabs dang rjes gnang sogs thob pas kyang de dang de sgom du rung zhing*/ ci nas kyang slob dpon la bka' de 'dra ba re ni thob par byed pa lag len rnam dag gi rgyun la 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin no// //dri ba gnyis pa/ dbang gsum pa'i ye shes las gzhan pa'i/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes ji ltar yod/ ces pa ste/ de la brjod pa/ re zhig dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes ni/ dbang gsum pa'i ye shes las ngo bo shin tu tha dad pa yin no zhes dam 'cha' dgos/ de'i don cung zad tsam brjod na/ spyir 'phags pa'i yul gyi rdo rje 'dzin pa 'gangs chen po rnams la yang bzhed pa mi 'dra ba du ma yod par yang bshad/ mi 'dra ba ci rigs pa so sos mdzad pa'i gsung rab rnams la dngos su yang snang*/ de la rdo rje slob dpon rgyud gzhung mang po la mkhas shing*/ nus mthu dang byin rlabs kyi gzi byin chen po mnga' ba rnams la rgya gar gyi yul du slob dpon chen por brtsi ba 'dug /ngo mtshar yang shin tu che ba lags mod/ 'on kyang de tsam gyis rdzogs rim gyi nges don mthar thug rtogs pa'i khyab pa rang yang med cing*/ de rtogs su chug kyang gdul bya'i blo ngo la ltos nas drang don tsam gsung ba yang srid/ nges don nyid gsung du chug kyang*/ de ngo sprod pa'i thabs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'byung srid pas/ lugs tha dad pa de rnams la'ang gcig tu tshad ldan no zhe bzhag par dka' mod/

mtha' gcig tu nor ro zhes kyang dgag par dka' bas/ re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag cing*/ mchog tu tshad ldan du gyur pa sems 'grel skor gsum yin la/ gzhan yang bram ze chen po'i do ha dang*/ rim lnga/ zhal lung sogs kyi dgongs pa dang bstun na/ bzhi pa'i ye shes ni/ don dam pa'i ye shes rang bzhin lhan skyes zhes bya ba de yin la/ gsum pa'i ye shes ni/ zhu bde lhan skyes kun rdzob dpe'i ye shes so/ /de yang sems 'grel skor gsum nas/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zung du 'jug pa la bzhi pa mtshan nyid par bshad pa dang*/ bram ze chen pos kyang*/ grogs dag zab mo dang ni rgya che ba gzhan med bdag nyid ma yin no/ /lhan cig skyes dga' bzhi pa'i dus/ / gnyug ma nyams su myong bas shes/ /zhes dang*/ de ltar yin te de ni ma yin no/ /zhes sogs dang*/ gzhan yang mang du gsungs shing*/ rim lnga spyod bsdus sogs kyi dgongs pa'ang*/ bzhi pa mtshan nyid pa ni/ sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug la bzhed cing*/ zhal lung grol thig gnyis las kyang*/ zab gsal dbyer med la 'chad la/ sbyor ba bdun pa'i gzhung rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang*/ bzhi pa'i ye shes kha sbyor yan lag bdun du bshad pas/ de rnams dgongs pa gcig ste/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs dang*/ sgyu lus dang*/ gsal ba dang*/ kha sbyor dang bcas pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa rnams don gcig cing*/ mi 'gyur bde chen dang*/ 'od gsal dang*/ zab pa dang*/ rang bzhin med pa dang bcas pa'i bde ba'i yan lag rnams don gcig pas so/ /des na dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo ni/ bcos ma ma yin pa'i bde ba dang*/ stong pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gsum zung du 'jug pa gcig yin la/ de'i khyad par yang*/ bde ba ni sems nyid bde ba dang*/ de'i rten thig le 'gyur ba med pa gnyis yin zhing*/

de yang ji srid rdul phra rab kyi tshogs par snang ba yod phyin chad mi 'gyur ba ma yin pas/ de 'gags nas ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa na/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde bar 'jog cing*/ bde ba chen por lhag par rigs pa yod kyang*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang 'gags pa ni de'i stong pa yin la/ bde ba de nyid dag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i 'khor 'das kyi rnam pa thams cad dang mtshungs pa'i snang char 'char ba ni dkyil 'khor yin no/ /de ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor las 'thob par 'gyur zhing*/ thob tshul yang sems kyi chos nyid dam/ rang bzhin bde stong gsal ba zung du 'jug par gnas pa de lam gyi stobs kyis dri ma bsal nas mngon du gyur pa yin la/ de yang gdod nas lhun rdzogs su grub pa la/ dri ma tsam bsal bar 'dod pa dang*/ dang po rigs sam sa bon gyi tshul du gnas pa/ phyis dri ma'ang bsal zhing*/ ngo bo'ang 'phel rgyas su 'dod pa ni/ rang rang gi grub mtha'i dbang las gang la sbyar kyang 'grig la/ spyir de gnyis ji ltar 'thad logs su gtan la dbabs dgos mod/ 'dir skabs kyi don ma yin pas bzhag go /las dang po pa la bzhi pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ de dus bzhi pa'i ye shes mi skye yang*/ de'i lam nyan pa dang*/ sgom du rung bar byed cing*/ phyis ye shes de skye ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig byed yin pas/ tshig dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i brdar gzhag pa yin no/ /gsum pa'i ye shes la ni/ 'dod tshul mi 'dra bar che ba med mod kyi/ ngo bo ni/ las sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten pa gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya rtsol dang rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las/ byung ba'i glo bur ba'i shes pa yin no/ /des na 'jig med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhal snga nas/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes de nyid bzhi pa'i myu gur gyur pa zhes gsungs pa yang*/ de sgom pas bzhi ba 'thob par 'gyur ba tsam la dgongs pa yin na snga ma rnams dang mthun pas legs la/

gsum pa'i rigs rgyun de nyid bzhi par 'gyur ro zhes dgongs na ni nges don gyi grub mtha' min no/ /de bzhin du lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs zhes grags pa yang*/ bzhi pa rtogs pa'i rgyu thun mong ma yin pa la bzhi pa'i lam du brtags pa yin na legs por 'gyur zhing*/ bod sgom phal che ba gnas lugs phyag rgya chen por grags pa bzhi pa'i ye shes su 'dod pa ni/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid kyi zur gyi stong pa'i rigs tsam du 'gro ba srid kyang*/ bzhi pa'i bde ba dang gsal ba ma tshang bas bzhi ba dngos su ni mi 'gyur ro/ /'o na stong pa de dang gtum mo'am las rgya'i bde ba dang*/ sgom bzlas kyi lha sku rnams kyang rig pa skad cig ma gcig la dus mnyam du tshogs na bzhi par 'gyur ba ma yin nam zhe na/ de dag bzhi pa'i ye shes kyi brgyud pa'i rgyu tshogs su ni cis kyang 'gyur ba'i skabs yod mod/ bskyed rim gyi : ltas [ lhas ] don dam gyi lha sku'i go mi chod cing*/ las rgya'i bde ba tsam gyis kyang phyag chen gyi bde ba'i go mi chod do/ /des na gang dag sems gsal la ngos bzung med pa bzhag thabs bde ba tsam zhig 'dug pa la/ rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yin du re ste/ rig pa skad cig snga phyi gang la yang rnam pa mi 'dra ba med pas mi 'gyur ba dang*/ gnas pa'am 'gyu ba gang la yang bya thabs bde bas/ bde ba'o snyam du bsam zhing*/ ci yang ma yin pa'i sems kyi snang cha/ snang ba thams cad la 'char rung tsam 'di ka rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po yin du re ste/ rang bzhin thabs cir yang ma grub pas stong pa/ snang ba cir yang 'char bas rnam kun mchog ldan gyi gzugs so zhes sems pa de dag ni/ mdo sngags thun mong gi lta ba'i gnas la nges shes ma nor ba tsam yin du chug kyang*/ bzhi par 'dod pa de ni/ rgyud sde'i nges gsang las shin tu phyir phyogs pa yin cing*/

de dang des de dag gi go chod pa yang ma yin pas gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po tsam bzhi par mi 'gyur ro/ /des na sgom chen pa byings dmangs kyi 'dod pa ltar/ lta ba tsam la bzhi par 'dod pa de yang min/ sngon gyi sngags pa 'ga' zhig 'dod pa ltar/ kun rdzob kyi bde ba'i khyad par gcig tsam mam/ de la mi rtog pa'am/ stong nyid mos sgom tsam gyis rgyas 'debs byed pa la bzhi pa dngos su 'dod pa de yang min/ bod phyis byung 'ga' zhig 'dod pa ltar kun rdzob kyi bde ba dang*/ rjes dpag gis rtogs pa'i stong nyid dang*/ 'byung lus kyi lha sku gsum ngo bo tha dad dus gcig tu 'dzom pa zhig la 'dod pa ltar ni ga la zhig ste/ mdor na gong du bstan zin kyang slar yang gsal bar brjod pa ni/ rdzogs rim sna tshogs pa'i rkyen gyis rlung sems dbu mar 'gags pa'i zhu bde khyad par can thob/ de nas de ring du goms pas gtum mo 'bar ba dang sems nyid dbyer med du 'dres pas/ de nyid sgyu lus kyi dkyil 'khor ram/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba der mngon du 'gyur/ de dang mnyam par sbyar ba'i rjes chags kyi rkyen zhig las/ thog mar 'dzag med kyi zhu bde re 'byung zhing*/ zhu bde'i rten thig le re yod pa de yang*/ zhu bde shar ba'i skad cig ma gnyis pa der/ 'byung lus su snang ba dag ste/ gong du bshad pa'i stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po der gyur pa na/ brten pa sems bde ba de yang mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zhes bya bar gyur zhing*/ des na bzhi pa'i ye shes kyi gsal ba dang bde ba de 'dra zhig yin la/ de'i dus na lus thig le la sogs pa gnas gyur gyi stong gzugs de yang sems nyid bde ba de dang ngo bo gcig pa ni/ sku dang ye shes zung 'jug gi char gtogs pa yin na/ de lta bu'i zung 'jug de yang ye shes kho na yin pas/ gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa dngos gnas la yang ma yin zhing*/

ye shes de nyid rang la'ang gzung 'dzin mi snang ba'i phyir/ de nyid stong pa yang yin no/ /de ltar na/ bde stong gsal ba gsum ngo bo gcig pa'i ye shes de ni bzhi pa mtshan nyid pa yin zhing*/ sems 'grel skor kho na'i chos skad ltar na/ 'di la don dam pa'i dbang bzhi pa dang*/ bzhi pa chen po dang*/ don dam pa'i shes rab ye shes dang*/ shes rab ye shes chen po zhes bshad cing*/ don la dbang bzhi'i zlas phye ba'i bzhi pa de yin la/ gzhan 'jig rten pa'i dbang bzhi pa zhes bya ba gsum pa'i khongs su gtogs pa zhig kyang bshad do/ /gzhan yang ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ zhes pa'i skabs su dbang gsum pa'i ye shes 'di ni zhes dam pa snga ma mang pos bshad cing phyis de'i don la dpyad pa med par khas len pa snang ngo*/ /snga ma rnams kyi dgongs pa dpe la sbyar ba'i bshad pa ste/ bzhi pa'i dpe gsum pa yin pa la dgongs nas cung zad phra ba dang*/ rdul dang cung zad bral ba sogs dper byas nas/ don bzhi pa mtshon pa yin na mi 'gal mod/ phyis kyi 'dod pa ltar na/ shin tu phra ba sogs ma yin pas mi 'thad do/ /tshig don ni 'di yin te/ gdod ma'i ye shes lam gyis gsal par byas pa'i lhan skyes 'di ni sgra rtog las 'das shing rang rig kho nas nyams su myong bya yin pas ches phra ba ma rig pa sogs rnam rtog gi rdul dang bral/ 'di sgoms na thar pa ster zhing bde ba myong bas zhi ba nyid de/ mi 'gyur ba'i phyir rdo rje snying po/ spros pa dang bral ba'i phyir nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/ rang gis rang nyid mtshon dgos pa'i phyir/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /zhes pa ste/ 'dir dkyil dang snying po ni 'gyur gyi khyad par te maṇ+ḍa zhes bya ba'i sgra las so/ /des na/ gong du bshad pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba la'ang rdzogs ma rdzogs kyi dbye ba du ma yod cing*/ gzhan yang mtha' gcod mang po dgos pa zhig yod na'ang re zhig de tsam mo/

/ dri ba gsum pa/ yang gser thur du rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la bla med kyis rgyas bkab nas/ dbang bzhi rim gnyis rung bar bshad na/ de 'dra'i dbang rgyun nam/ dbang chog tshad ldan bla ma gong mas sbyar ba ji ltar yod/ ces pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ 'di ni gtso bor don thob la 'byung zhing*/ de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor ram sgrub thabs phra mo'i rigs kyi lha dang sngags la rnal 'byor bla med nas bshad pa'i dang po stong nyid byang chub ste/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor thun mong ba'i chings sbyar ba/ rgya gzhung tshad ldan mtha' yas pa zhig 'dug pa thun mong sgrub byed kyi lha'i rnal 'byor de yang bla med kho na'i lugs yin pas/ de sbyar du rung phyin/ mchog sgrub byed kyi chings bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi sogs bskyed rim gyi chings kyang sbyor du rung dgos shing*/ de rung phyin chad rdzogs rim kyang rung dgos te/ bskyed rim gyi yan lag re res kyang rdzogs rim gyi smin byed khyad par can byed pa'i phyir ro/ /rim pa gnyis yod pas dbang bzhi yang yod dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang*/ slob dpon pā ra he tas mdzad pa'i pad+ma'i phyag gi sgrub thabs lta bu yang*/ bya rgyud kyi lha sngags la/ bla med kyi bskyed rim gyi chings sbyar zhing*/ bla med dang bstun nas kha sbyor gyi skur mdzad pa sogs gzhan yang ci rigs snang bas de dag la dbang yang bzhi rdzogs su bskur dgos la/ bya rgyud nas bshad pa'i lha sngags kyi sgrub thabs la/ phra thig sogs kyi rdzogs rim than thun sbyar ba yang mang du snang bas/ rgyud gzhung gi khungs kyang yod cing*/ bod kyi grub thob gong ma'i man ngag ni shin tu yang mang ngo*// da dung 'di'i 'phros dri lan bzhi par 'byung ngo*// //dri ba bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje 'phreng ba lta bu dkyil chog gcig gis rgyud sde tha dad mang po la/

'jug pa la/ deng sang phyag len dag pa'i phyogs la/ rnal 'byor rgyud man chad la rgyud sde rang rang dang bstun nas cho ga la 'dor len mdzad kyin 'dug pa ji ltar yin/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ de yang dang por cho ga gcig gis rgyud sde mang po la 'jug pa zhes pa'i skabs 'dir/ 'di ltar go dgos te/ bla med lta bu rgyud rigs mthun pa la ni/ cho ga gcig gis kyang chog pa yin te/ de yang cho ga'i babs gcig kho na las/ dmigs gsal shin tu mi 'dra ba rgyud nyid nas gsal por thon pa rnams/ rgyud de dang de'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la so sor sbyor ba tsam mdzad pa ni/ 'phags yul gyi chen po phal cher zhig gi lugs yin zhing*/ de ni ches bzang la/ mi 'dra ba'i dmigs gsal yod pa'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor la yang*/ gsang ba spyi'i cho ga kho na las thun mong ma yin pa'i sne bsgyur ba med kyang*/ spyi'i cho ga de rnam dag yin phyin chad/ dkyil 'khor tha dad pa de dang de'i cho ga yang rnam par dag par 'gyur zhing*/ so so'i thun mong ma yin pa'i cho ga des kyang dmigs gsal med pa gzhan gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang bskur du rung ba'ang yin no/ /de yang dus 'khor dang mi g.yo ba bla med lta bu nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i cho ga'ang gsal bar gsungs la/ gzhan rnams phal cher cho ga'i ngo bo gcig par dgongs te/ de yang gsang 'dus rdo rje 'phreng pa las/ cho ga nyi shu cha tshang bar gsungs pa/ rgyud tshig dngos bstan la/ dbang chog gsal shos dang rgyas shos rang la snang zhing*/ sdom 'byung nas cho ga'i go rim dang*/ rnam grangs rnams sdoms kyi tshul du gsal bar gsungs/ kha sbyor phyi ma las kyang de dang mtshungs/ rdo rje gur nas dbang gi dngos gzhi'i cho ga'i tshig dang*/ gdan bzhi nas 'jug pa'i rim pa rnams tshang rung tsam du gsungs/ lhag ma rgyud phal cher las cha shas cha shas tsam las ma gsungs te/ des na sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis/

de dag las ji ltar 'os pa dang*/ de'i steng du de nyid bsdus pa dang*/ gsang ba spyi rgyud dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang sogs kyis kha bskang nas/ rang rang so so'i man ngag dang mthun par dkyil chog mdzad par snang zhing*/ de yang dper na klu byang gis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog nyi shu pa dang*/ mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa'i bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa yang gsang 'dus rtsa bshad kyi rgyud kho na la brten pa yang ma yin la/ de'i steng du spyi rgyud tsam la brten pa kho na yang ma yin te/ bla med pha ma'i rgyud sna tshogs nas bsdus pa yin pas/ bla med nyid kyi gsang ba'i spyi'i cho ga nyid yin no/ /'on kyang slob dpon de dag rang 'dus pa la gtso bor mdzad pa'am/ gzhan gyis bskul ba sogs las/ cho ga de dkyil 'khor gang la sbyar kyang rung ba'i sbyor tshul shes pa'i phyir du dper brjod pa'i tshul gyis/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la sbyor bar mdzad pas/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil chog ces grags pa yin zhing*/ don du ni klu byang gi rjes su 'brang zhing*/ de'i gdams ngag brgyud pa can yin na/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i dbang bskur byed kyang*/ cho ga'i chings dkyil chog nyi shu pa ltar byed dgos shing*/ mar me mdzad bzang po'i rjes su 'brang na/ dkyil 'khor thams cad la bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa ltar sbyor ba yin no/ /de bzhin du/ laṅga'i dkyil chog dgu brgya pa dang*/ mi thub zla ba'i bzang po yongs bzung sogs 'phags yul du snga rabs byung ba'i dkyil chog phal che ba zhig de 'dra'i rigs yin la/ phyis sngon gyi slob dpon gcig kho na'i man ngag las rgyud sde mang po'i dbang rgyun ma thob pa rnams/ rgyud sde so so la slob dpon tha dad kyi man ngag la brten nas dbang bskur ba so so zhes pa la brten te/ lugs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs par gyur pa yin no/ /de bzhin du sems 'grel gyi rjes su 'brang ba ltar na/

dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i chings kyis/ 'dus pa la sogs par dbang bskur zhing*/ des mtshon nas gzhan dang gzhan yang 'byung bar 'gyur te/ rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga khyab 'jug sbas pas mdzad pa bzhin no/ /'di dag gi rgyu mtshan yang*/ 'dus pa rtsa bshad kyi rgyud kho na las btus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhig yod na/ 'dus pa kho na la sbyor ba dang*/ sdom pa rtsa bshad kho na las btus pa'i cho ga zhig yod na yang*/ de nyid kho nas sbyor zhing gzhan la mi sbyor ba 'thad 'thad 'dra na'ang*/ rgyud sde rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs nas bsdus pa'i cho ga mnyam po la/ dkyil 'khor tha dad la ma 'dres par sbyor dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags yul gyi slob dpon gcig gi man ngag rgyun ma 'chugs par byung ba'i pod rnying pa la yang de bzhin du yod de/ pham ting pa'i man ngag 'dzin pa rnams 'khor lo sdom pa dang gshin rje gshed kyi cho ga yang*/ cho ga'i khrigs gcig gi steng nas byed pa lta bu'o/ /'ong kyang da lta man ngag so so ba'i rgyun ma chad pa'i lag len thob pa rnams kyis ni de de'i lugs ma 'dres par byas na/ byin brlabs kyi bka' babs bzang ba yin no// 'di dag dngos lan ma yin kyang*/ da lta phal gyi blo la 'phreng ba la sogs pa 'di kun ni gsang ba spyi'i cho ga yin la/ dkyil chog nyi shu pa la sogs pa 'di rnams ni sgos kyi cho ga yin gyi/ dkyil 'khor mang po la mi 'jug go snyam pa'i/ bye brag med pa la bye brag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa ldog pa'i phyir yin no/ /dngos kyi lan ni/ 'phreng ba las/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gcig kho na gsungs shing*/ rgyud sde'i rim pa'i 'dor len gyi gsal ka yang mi snang ba dang*/ rdzogs 'phreng dang*/ rdo rje 'phreng ba nyid kyi thig gi skabs dang rdul tshon bri ba'i skabs rnams dkyil 'khor gyi go rim gcig par yod kyang*/

rim pa de dag dkyil 'khor bri ba sogs la mthun sdebs kyi go rim ma gtogs/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor sde tshan so sor mdzad pa yang mi snang zhing*/ rdor dbyings la sogs pa 'di dag la rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor yin no zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyud sde so so'i ming gsal mdzad pa yang ye mi snang*/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs su ma zad dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang*/ mchod gtor sogs gnas skabs ji lta bu zhig la yang dbye ba ye ma mdzad pas/ 'phreng ba mkhan po'i bzhed pa ni thams cad kyang bla med kyi lugs su gsal bas/ bum dbang ni nges par bla med kyi lugs su bskur na bde zhing*/ spyir 'di'i lugs la dbang gong ma yang byed pa nyid legs so/ /'phreng ba la bod kyi lag len rgyud sde'i dbye ba byed tshul 'di ni rig pas kyang mi 'thad par snang ste/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi skabs rig pa'i dbang lnga sogs la cho ga'i chings thams cad bla med yin pa la/ rigs lnga la sogs pa'i lha'i rnam pa rnal 'byor rgyud ltar byas pas/ rgyud sde gnyis po gang gi yang cho gar ma gtogs pa'i skyon dang*/ rgyud sde gong ma'i rgyud tshig gis rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur bas spyod rgyud kyi dbang gi go mi chod pa dang*/ spyod rgyud kyi dbang lnga la rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lha bskyed pa mi 'thad pa dang*/ rigs lnga de 'dra bskyed pa 'phreng ba'i dngos shugs gang la yang med pa dang*/ bya rgyud kyi skabs chu cod kyi dbang la/ spyod rgyud kyi skabs la brjod pa'i skyon rnams 'jug gi steng du/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i nang nas gnyis kyi dbang yod la/ gsum gyi dbang mi byed pas rang bzo'i dngos rtags chen po bstan pa dang*/ ci ste slob ma dang dbang rdzas lhar mi bskyed na/ 'phreng ba dang dngos su 'gal ba'i chu dang cod pan gyi dbang chog gis dbang bskur ba 'phreng ba'i lugs su mi 'gyur ba dang*/

de gsum ka'i skabs su dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang*/ gtor ma byin rlabs sogs kyang rang blos dpyad nas gsar du rtsom dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ sa chog la sogs pa cho ga'i yan lag gzhan thams cad bla med kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i cho gas sgrubs phyin dngos gzhi'i cho ga de dag la/ bla med kyi thun mong ma yin pa rnams byed du mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na chu cod kyi dbang yin pa tsam gyis bya rgyud lugs kyi dbang du mi 'gyur/ bya rgyud lugs su byed na/ bya rgyud rang nyid nas bshad pa'i chu dang cod pan gyi dbang dgos te/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /ye shes thig le'i rgyud las rgyud lnga'i dbang gi rnam grangs gsungs pa rnams ni/ so so'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ dngos grub gnyis ka sgrub pa'i dbang du byas nas cho ga rgyas shos la dgongs pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na nyi tshe tsam gyis chog pa'ang yod de/ bya rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor phra mo mang po la'ang rig sngags kyi dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba/ bum chu kho na'i dbang bskur gyis chog pa dang*/ bla med la yang slob ma'i skal ba dang 'tshams par rim pa sna tshogs pa dang*/ khyad par sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las dug gso ba'i skabs na/ chu dbang bsdus pa tsam gsungs pa lta bu mang du yod pa yang shes par bya'o/ /des na/ rgyud sde 'og ma'i dkyil 'khor la dbang bzhi yod pa'i dbang chog tshad ldan dang*/ dbang rgyun ni de lta bu yin par snang ngo*// //dri ba lnga pa ni/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ in+d+ra bhū tis spros bcas kyi spyod pa mdzad ces pa la/ ṭī ka rnams su spros bcas btags pa bar bshad pa dang*/ bhu su ku der spros med du bshad cing*/ gzhan las shin tu spros med du bshad pa dang*/ de gnyis spros bcas dang spros med ma yin na/ rab dbye'i gzhung du spyod pa gnyis kyi mtshan gzhi yin nges shes pa 'dzin rgyu yod bzhin du/

ma yin pa zhig bzung ba la dgos pa ci/ zhes pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ spyir ni 'di dang 'di'i rigs 'og na'ang cung zad snang ba la/ lan brjod pa ni/ dus kyi tha ma 'di lta bur cung zad bya dka' ba zhig ste/ dri lan gyi yi ge rim pas 'phyan pa na/ gzhung 'di'i phyogs 'dzin dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba 'ga' zhig khong 'khrug par 'gyur ba'i nyes pa dang gzhung 'di la sdang ba rnams phal cher rgyud sde la mi 'gris pa'i phyir/ sngan chad glan ka 'tshol ba'i go skabs ma rnyed pa/ phyis go skabs rnyed par 'gyur ba'i gnas yod pas so/ /'on kyang 'di dag la gsong por smra bar bya ste/ 'di la gnyis/ gzhung mdzad pa po'i dgongs pa brjod pa dang*/ 'thad pa'i phyogs bzhag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa yang rgyud sde'i dbye bas gnyis te/ bla med spyi tsam nas bshad pa dang khyad par can gyi'o/ /dang po ni pha rgyud thun mong ste/ spyod bsdus sgron me las bshad pa'i spyod pa gsum po de pha rgyud rang lugs kyi/ de gsum so so yin pa smos ma dgos kyang*/ bla med kyi rgyud nas bshad pa'i spyod pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdus na/ spyod bsdus nas bshad pa'i spros bcas spros med de gnyis ka cho ga dang bya ba rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par tsam ma gtogs/ tshogs kyi khang par lha'i chas su zhugs nas/ dngos kyi rig ma dang bcas te/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo la rtag tu spyod par mthun pas/ spyi ldog nas spros bcas su 'du la/ de'i shin tu spros med bhu su ku zhes bya ba de ni phyi'i spros pa gzhan spangs kyang*/ kha zas kyi yon bdag sgrub cing*/ snying kha nas sprul pa'i ye shes kyi rig ma dgos pa'i phyir/ bskyed rim gyi phyogs la brten pa ltar snang bas/ spros med tsam du 'jog ces dgongs pa dang*/ bde dgyes nas 'byung ba'i spyod pa gsum/ khyad par kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa yul chen rnams su rgyu ba 'di ni/

bla med kyi rgyud khyad par can gyi lugs te/ 'dod yon sna tshogs dang bde sdug thams cad ro mnyam par byed pa'i phyir/ shin tu spros med de spyod pa'i mchog yin cing*/ bir+wa ṭoṃ bi lū dril nag gsum te lo nā ro sogs grub thob phal mo ches 'di mdzad do snyam du dgongs nas gzhung du yang bkod pa yin no/ /'grel pas spros bcas btags pa bar 'chad pa ni/ in+d+ra bhū ti'i de ye shes kyi rnam rol yin pas spros bcas su mi 'thad snyam du bsams pa yin kyang*/ 'dir ni cho ga dang*/ bya ba mang nyung la spros pa che chung du bzhag pa yin pas/ ye shes kyi rnam rol yin kyang spros bcas yin pa mi 'gal zhing*/ rab dbye mdzad pa'i bzhed pa'ang*/ in+d+ra bhū tis spyong gzhan ma mdzad ces pa min gyi/ spros bcas kyi spyod pa dngos de lan gcig nges par mdzad pa yin par bzhed do/ /bhu su ku'i spyod pa yang spyi ldog nas spros med kyi spyod pa tsam yin kyang*/ pha rgyud rang rkang gi lugs la shin tu spros med du 'jog pa'ang mi 'gal bar dgongs shing*/ bla ma gong ma 'di rnams kyi bzhed tshul la/ bskyed rdzogs spyod gsum gyi skabs thams cad du/ pha rgyud las bde dgyes sogs mchog tu 'gyur tshul gyi mtho dman re bzhed par snang ngo*/ /des na bzhed pa 'di la yang nang 'gal ni med do/ /gnyis pa ni/ ma rgyud rnams las zhing gi rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi 'du ba thob pa'i phyir/ gnas chen rnams su rgyu bar gsungs pa sogs rgyud kyi bstan tshul rgya che chung cung zad yod kyang*/ spyod pa rang gi ngo bo ni/ spyod bsdus las gsungs pa'i spyod pa gsum du/ ma rgyud las bshad pa'i kun 'dar/ kun bzang*/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gsum yang 'dus shing*/ de gsum du spyod bsdus kyi de gsum yang 'dus pas/ dbye sgo mi 'dra ba tsam yin no/ /zhes dang*/ bhu su ku shin tu spros med kho nar lung rigs gnyis kas 'thad cing*/

spyod pa gsum gyi mtshan nyid spyi ldog nas rgyud gzhung rnams dang bstun nas smras na legs kyi/ in+d+ra bhū ti dang grub thob rnams kyis spyod pa gang zhig mdzad pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo zhes kho bo smra'o/ /'di la da dung mtha' gcod dgos pa yod do// //dri ba drug pa ni/ bum dbang gis tshogs lam chen po tsam bgrod pa dang*/ yang sa drug pa'i brgyad pa man chad bgrod par bshad pa dang*/ yang bskyed rim 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub kho na sgrub byed du gsungs pa rnams mi 'gal ba'i tshul ci yin/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ tshogs lam chen po tsam bgrod pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub kho na sgrub byed du gsungs pa gnad gcig ste/ bskyed rim la brten nas 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub chen po thob pa rnams tshogs lam chen po thob pa'i gang zag yin pas so/ /bskyed rim 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub kho na'i sgrub byed du/ dus 'khor las bshad pa na/ bskyed rim gyi dngos 'bras ji ltar mthar thug kyang*/ gzugs khams las mi 'da' ba dang*/ mchog gi rgyu min par gsungs pa yang*/ dngos rgyu yang min zhing*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu yang min pas/ de med par yang mchog 'grub pa srid pa'i don no/ /'di na 'dod tshul sna tshogs pa zhig yod kyang*/ kho bo rang lugs kyi 'dod pa rnams ni/ grub thob zhi ba'i zhabs kyi bzhed pa dang bstun pa yin zhing*/ bzhed pa de yang bla med kyi rgyud sde sna tshogs dgongs pa gcig tu sgril zhing*/ rim lnga/ zhal lung*/ dpyid thig /dri med 'od sogs kyi don gyi snying po bsdus par snang bas/ lugs 'di ni skyon bral yon tan kun ldan yin la/ sngar gyi rnams la sna tshogs zhig snang ba/ mtha' dag rang lugs su mi 'dod cing*/ 'dir yang bum dbang la sa drug brgyad sbyor ba ni nged kyi grub mtha' la ni mi 'dod/ 'on kyang bum dbang gis sa drug bgrod pa'i don ni/

sa drug bum dbang gi grub mtha' yin zhing*/ grub mtha'i don ni grub 'bras yin kyang*/ 'bras bu zhes brjod na mthar thug dang nor gyis dogs pa yin pas/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu las phar ring du brgal/ mthar thug gi 'bras bur ma sleb pa'i bar skabs kyi 'bras bu la zer ba yin pas/ sngon bskyed rim bsgoms pa las brgyud cing brten pa'i dge tshogs kyi phan yon thams cad/ sa drug po de la rtsol med du 'chad pa'i don no/ /de lta na yang bskyed rim gyis de thob pa min te/ 'bras bu sprul sku bzhin no/ /rim lnga las/ dang po'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sa brgyad pa ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /snang ba gsum po mthong ba dang*/ /sa bcu pa la rab tu gnas/ /zhes pa dang*/ spyod bsdus las kyang de mthun du gsungs pa ni/ bskyed rim pa dang sems dben pa'i gang zag de/ nyams rtogs de nyid la gnas pa'i rang dus de na/ mdo lugs kyi sa brgyad pa dang*/ bcu pa tsam po la gnas pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas 'thob pa la thag nye ring 'dra ba'i don te/ 'di tsam zhig ni rang lugs la khas len no// //dri ba bdun pa/ mdo lam kho nas sangs rgyas mi thob pa'i don/ de las kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi sku sgrub byed kyi thabs ma gsungs pa la thug pa 'dra na/ mdo kho nas sa dang po yang ji ltar 'thob/ zhes pa dang*/ de las 'phros pa/ dri ba brgyad pa ni/ mdo lam kho nas sa dang po thob na/ yan lag bdun gyi sku rjes mthun pa zhig kyang 'thob dgos pa 'dra na ji ltar yin/ /zhes pa dang*/ de gnyis las 'phros pa/ dri ba dgu pa ni/ mdo lam kho nas rlung sems tsam gyi lha sku mi 'grub pa 'dra na/ sbyor lam rtse mo yang ji ltar 'thob/ /zhes pa dang de gsum ka las 'phros pa/ dri ba bcu pa ni/ mdo sngags kyi lam thad so'i byang sems rnams la/ spangs rtogs kyi yon tan gyi khyad par rang ni med lags sam/ /zhes pa ste/ de ltar na dri ba bzhi po 'di rnams la brjod pa/

mdo lam kho nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su bgrod mi nus pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yang yin mod kyi/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ spang bya gnas skabs bzhi'i bag chags phra ba rab kyi mthar thug pa de spong mi thub pa dang*/ 'thob bya bde ba chen po'i sku bsgrub pa'i thabs med pas yin no/ /de dag gi go don yang gnas skabs bzhi'i bag chags phra rab dang*/ snang ba gsum gyi sgrib pa phra mo dang*/ 'pho ba'i bag chags phra mo dang*/ 'gyur ba'i bag chags phra mo dang*/ bzhi pa chags rtog gi bag chags phra mo rnams don gcig /dngos po lus ngag yid gsum gyi gzung 'dzin gnyis snang phra mo yin zhing*/ de nyid 'dzag bde'i bag chags kyang yin pas/ 'di chags chen gyi lam gyis spong dgos pa yin la/ de yang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la gnyis snang ma zad kyi bar du/ phyi snang ba'i gnyis snang rab 'byams kyang zad par mi 'gyur zhing*/ de zad na de yang ma lus pa spong bar 'gyur te/ ji ltar mar me ma zad kyi bar du/ de'i 'od kyang rgyun mi 'chad la/ de 'gags na de yang 'gag pa bzhin no/ /des na/ sa bcu rgyun mtha'i snga log yan chad du/ dkar dmar rlung gsum gyi snang ba yod cing*/ de gsum la cha mnyam du 'jug pa'i sems kyang yod pas/ de rnams gnyis snang gi rang bzhin can yin la/ 'on kyang sa bcu pa de la/ de rnams bem chos su snang ba ni med cing*/ rnam par shes pa tsam du rig pa yin kyang*/ shes pa nyid gzung 'dzin gnyis snang can du shar ba yin no/ /de las rten khu ba ni lus dang*/ rdul ni ngag dang*/ rlung ni sems kyis gnyis snang bskyed pa'i chos yin la/ de rnams la ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i yid ni/ 'dzag bde'i gnyis snang gi cha shas can te/ de yang rlung gi g.yo ba phra mos khrag gi cha yang 'bar ba phra mo'i rang bzhin can no/ /des khu ba'i cha yang zhu ba phra mo'i rang bzhin can shar ba de/ sems yid des zhu bder nyams su myong ba'i cha shas yod pa'i phyir ro/

/de ltar na sems kyi snang ba tsam gyi/ khu rdul rlung gsum rdzas dang ngo bo gcig kyang*/ rnal 'byor pa'i sems la tha dad du snang ba'i 'khrul ba can de ni khams 'gyur ba'i bag chags phra mo yin la/ de nyams su myong ba'i sems yid de yang chags sred kyi bag chags phra mo can yin pas/ de sbyong bar byed pa yang*/ dus der 'dod chags chen po'i lam gyis dbang bskur ba yin te/ der yang dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i rjes chags kyi rkyen gyis rlung bskyod pas gtum mo dmar cha 'bar bar byed la/ des dkar cha zhu ba'i yas babs kyi dga' ba'i tha mar/ mas brtan gyi tshe dkar dmar ro gcig par gyur pa la/ dmar chas dbang byas pa zhes ming du btags shing*/ mas brtan de nyid kyi mthar/ dkar po gtsug tor tu thim zhing*/ dmar po nor bur thim pas/ de'i skad cig gnyis par rlung yang 'gag ste/ de ltar khu rdul rlung gsum 'gags pas/ de gsum gyi 'gyur ba nyams su myong ba'i shes pa'i rigs rgyun yang chad pas/ sems nyid mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba kho nar gyur pa de la ni bde ba chen po'i sku zhes bya ste/ yan lag bdun gyi nang gi bde chen gyi yan lag yin la/ ye shes de nyid kyi ngo bo rnam pa med tsam ma yin te sngar gyi rgyun las mtshan dpe rdzogs pa dang*/ kha sbyor gyi sku rab 'byams zhing dang mchod par bcas pa yang 'byung ba ni sku rdo rje dang*/ bde chen de nyid gzhom med gsung gi sgra dbyangs sgra thams cad pa'i tshul du 'char ba ni gsung rdo rje dang*/ bde ba'i ye shes de kho nas ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad rnam par mi rtog bzhin du mkhyen pa ni thugs rdo rje dang*/ bde chen de nyid ye shes rdo rje yin la/ rdo rje bzhi po de nyid rim pa bzhin du khu rdul rlung yid bzhi dag pa'i 'bras bu yin zhing*/ sku bzhi yang yin no/ /'gyur bde 'khor ba'i rtsa bar gsungs pa yang*/

'gyur bde dngos ni ma dag pa'i 'khor ba ste/ rigs drug tu skye ba'i rgyu yin la/ 'gyur bde'i bag chags zhes bya ba gong du de ltar bshad pa de ni/ sa bcu so so la gnas pa'i 'phags pa rnams kyi/ rnam byang gi 'khor ba'i rgyu dngos yin zhing*/ rigs drug gi sems can 'khor ba pa rnams kyi rgyu la yang bag chags de la brten nas 'gyur bde dngos skye ba'i phyir/ 'khor ba dngos kyi brgyud pa'i rgyu yin par shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang tshor ba bde ba ni dkar po'i 'gyur ba dang*/ sdug bsngal ni dmar po'i 'gyur ba dang*/ btang snyoms kyang rlung gi 'gyur ba yin no/ /de gsum tshogs pa'i 'gyur bde'i cha shas ci rigs pa chags bral du grags pa rnams la'ang yod de/ khams gong ma gnyis na 'gyur bde rags pa mngon gyur pa yod cing*/ dgra bcom la yang bag chags kyi 'gyur bde yod pa yin la/ mngon pa sogs sde snod spyi khyab la grags pa ltar/ khams gong na 'khrig pa'i 'dod chags mngon gyur pa med pa'i lugs la yang*/ 'gyur bde tsam mngon gyur pa yod pa mi 'gal zhing*/ spyir ni gsang ba 'dus pa las/ 'dod khams gnas pa'i bud med ni/ /lha yi longs spyod rig brtul zhugs/ /yang na gzugs khams gnas pa la/ /stobs chen gyis ni 'dod pa spyad/ /ces pa dang*/ khams gsum dag gi lam gnas pa'i/ /bud med ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /gsung gi rdo rjes mi smad do/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ gang dag 'dus pa'i don la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa can du khas blangs nas/ khams gong na yang 'khrig pa'i 'dod chags ni/ yod ces smra ba sngon med gzhung lugs yin/ zhes zab mo'i rgyud la bskur pa 'debs pa yang mdzangs pa ma yin pa'i rnam thar ro/ /'on kyang sa dang po thob pa la ni/ 'gyur bde rags pa mngon gyur pa de spong dgos kyang*/ de spong byed chags chen gyi lam kho nar yang ma nges la/ yan lag bdun ldan gyi sku rjes mthun pa yang mdo lugs kyi der mi thob ste/

kha sbyor dang bde chen gnyis mi tshang bas so/ /mdo lam kyis sbyor lam rtse mo bgrod pa'i tshe na/ rlung sems tsam gyi lha sku dngos grub pa ma yin kyang*/ rjes mthun pa ni thob pa yin te/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin las/ mos spyod kyi sa'i skabs na rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin/ stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i gdan la gnas pa'i lus khyad par can/ khams gsum gyi lus las 'das pa 'grub par bshad do/ /'bras bu'i sangs rgyas la dbye ba med kyang*/ mdo sngags lam thad so so'i byang chub sems dpa' la ni/ yon tan gyi khyad par cung zad tsam yod par mngon la/ sa dang po thob ma thag pa thams cad yon tan mnyam par bshad pa dang*/ khyad par brgyad pa yan chad la de lta bu yang yang gsungs pa rnams ni/ mdo lugs kho na'i dbang du byas pa yin pas/ theg pa tha dad pa la de lta bu rtsi mi dgos par mngon no// //dri ba bcu gcig pa ni/ mthong lam las langs ma thag tu zung 'jug gi sku 'grub na brten pa don gyi 'od gsal dang*/ rten zung 'jug gi sku gnyis rim can du song*/ de lta na sangs rgyas kyi sar yang*/ longs sku'i rten la chos sku mngon du mdzad pa ji ltar yin/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ spyir don gyi 'od gsal thob pa'i thog ma mthong lam yin zhing*/ zung 'jug thob pa nas bzung sgom lam du 'gyur la/ mthong lam skad cig tha ma pa'i byang sems las/ sgom lam skad cig dang po pa de/ sku de thob pa'i yon tan gyis chos lhag cing*/ rten brten pa'i tha snyad ni/ lus sems kyi chos la so sor 'dogs pa yin kyang*/ skabs 'dir ye shes nyid skur shar ba yin pas/ sku dang ye shes zhes ldog cha tha dad du bzhag pa ma gtogs/ ngo bo gcig kho na yin pas zung 'jug ces bya zhing*/ des na sbyor lam rtse mo bzod pa chos mchog gsum la/ dag pa'i ye shes kyi sku ma thob kyang*/ rlung sems tsam gyi sku thob pas/ sgyu lus sam sku kho na 'grub pa tsam zer la/

mthong lam gyi skabs rang gi snang ngor sku de'i snang ba yang nub/ zung 'jug gi sku yang ma thob pas/ ye shes 'od gsal rkyang ba'i ming 'dogs shing*/ mnyam bzhag de las langs pa nas bzung*/ chos nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes dang*/ sku'i snang ba gnyis ka rgyun mi 'chad cing cha mnyam pa/ mnyam rjes thams cad du yod pas zung 'jug yin te/ de dag kyang gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas tha snyad de dang der btags pa yin te/ gzhan du na sbyor lam gyi dus na'ang bde stong gi ye shes med pa ma yin la/ mthong lam du yang rten lus tsam yod cing*/ zung 'jug la yang mnyam bzhag gsal zhing*/ rjes thob mi gsal ba yin no/ /de bzhin du zung 'jug gi mnyam bzhag kyang*/ lha sku gtso bor gyur pa'i dag pa'i snang ba can yin pas/ snang med la 'jog tu ye mi rung zhing*/ lha sku dang bde stong gnyis ka mnyam gzhag tu gsal mnyam dang*/ rjes thob tu cung zad mi gsal mnyam ste/ de yang rjes thob tu ni gnyis snang dang 'dres pa yin pa'i phyir/ bde stong cung zad mi gsal ba bzhin du/ tha mal gyi snang brnyan 'char ba yin pa'i phyir/ lha sku yang cung zad mi gsal ba yin no/ /des na 'od gsal las langs nas zung 'jug 'grub ces pa yang*/ mthong lam bde stong kho na la rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag pa'i 'od gsal dgos kyi ting nge 'dzin las langs pa yin zhing*/ de'i rjes thob kyang yin mod/ spyir mnyam par ma gzhag pa yang mtha' gcig tu min zhing*/ bde stong gi 'od gsal de sangs song ba min te/ des na zung du 'jug rgyu'i ya gyal gyi 'od gsal de mthong lam min pas/ ye shes dang sku res 'jog tu 'gyur ba'i skyon med la/ 'bras bu'i sku gsum po yang dus mnyam du 'thob dgos pa yin pas/ longs sku'i rten du chos sku mngon du mdzad pa sgra ji bzhin pa mi 'thad la/ 'on kyang longs sku'i rigs 'dra snga ma la/ longs sku'i ming gis btags par zad de/

rten de dang dus mnyam du yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du byas nas/ de'i skad cig gnyis pa la sku gsum dus mnyam du thob pa yin kyang*/ longs sku'i ming gis smos pas/ yang dag pa'i mtha' las longs skur ldang zhes grags pa yin zhing*/ de bzhin du longs sku'i rten la chos sku mngon du byed par grags pa yang*/ yang dag pa'i mtha' thog mar mngon du byas pa dang dus mnyam pa'i sku de'i skad cig gnyis pa la chos sku thob pa la bsam pa yin na rung ngo*// //dri ba bcu gnyis pa ni/ sa dang po thob pa dang*/ lte ba'i rtsa mdud grol bar gsungs pa'ang snang la/ mi phyed ma sogs rtsa bzhi'i rtsa mdud grol ba la yang sa dang por gsungs pa ji ltar yin/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ mi phyed ma sogs rtsa bzhi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas bzhir gnas shing*/ de rnams sa dang por gsungs la/ des mtshon nas rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi sa bcur gsungs pa ni/ sam+bu ṭa dang mngon brjod la sogs pa rgyud mang po las mgrin gcig tu gsungs/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i phyed byang chub kyi sems kyis brtan pa nas/ gtsug tor hril gyis brtan pa'i bar la sa bcu gnyis bzhag pa yang*/ sems 'grel skor gsum nas rgyas par bshad pa ltar/ gzhan yang phal cher gyi dgongs pa la gnas shing*/ 'di gnyis ni gnad gcig ste/ las byed pa'i rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ las bya ba'i rtsa 'khor lo drug la rtsa dang rlung gi khams ji ltar thim pa'i tshul gyi byung bar yin pas so/ /lte ba'i rtsa mdud grol bas/ sa dang po 'thob pa nged kyi grub mtha' la ni khas mi len/ 'on kyang 'khor lo drug 'khor lo bzhir bsdu ba dang mthun rung tsam yin pa 'dra/ sa 'di rnams thams cad kyang sbyor lam gyi sa yin zhing*/ 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rtsa dag pa'i byang phyogs kyi sa yang 'di dang 'dra ste/ rgyud dang grub chen rnams kyi dgongs pa de ltar yin yang*/ bod snga phyi phal cher 'phags pa'i sar 'dod pas/

de dag gis byas pa'i bstan bcos rnams 'chad pa'i tshe/ de rnams nyid rang rang so so'i grub mtha' dang ma bstun na nang 'gal 'ong pas/ de mtshungs su sbyor dgos so// //dri ba bcu gsum pa ni/ bdag med bstod 'grel dri ma med pa'i rgyan zhes bya bar/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i skabs su byang phyogs la 'phags lam lnga dang drug pa'i cha gsung ba 'di la don ji lta bu yin/ zhes pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ 'di nyid rang lugs la/ byang phyogs sa lam sogs sbyor tshul mi 'dra ba lnga gsungs pa'i nang gi 'phags lam dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa thun mong du byang phyogs so bdun tshar gcig sbyar ba'i lugs la/ sa dang po gnyis la bzhi bzhi dang*/ bar pa brgyad la gnyis gnyis/ bcu gcig pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pa'ang bzhi bzhi sbyar bas so gnyis song mtshams su/ ting nge 'dzin nas mar bgrangs pa'i drug pa yang dag pa'i ngag gi phyed dang*/ las mtha' 'tsho ba rtsol dran ting lnga po slob lam du mi thob par/ sangs rgyas thob pa dang mnyam du thob gsung ba'i go bar snang zhing*/ yang dag pa'i ngag la phyed mar mdzad pa ni rtsa mdud 'brel ma la cha bcas zhes/ phyed ma'i dag pa sbyar ba'i rigs 'gres su snang ngo*/ /'on kyang rtsa dang byang phyogs sbyor ba las sa lam gyi rim pa brtsi pa la khungs gsal po yod yod mi 'dra ba dang*/ khyad par sbyor tshul 'di ni sgos su lung gsal yod na ma gtogs/ dag sbyor skabs kyi rgyud dang ni mi mthun pas/ cung mi bde zhing*/ dgos kyi lung khungs phyogs 'gro yang kho bos ni sngar ma mthong ngo*/ /rtsa dang byang phyogs dag sbyor gyi rgyud kyi khungs la brten pa yin na/ spyir ni legs por 'gyur yang*/ sbyor tshul de ltar mi bya ste/ sum skor ma sogs bzhi dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi dang*/ mi phyed ma 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa yin pa nas/ yid bzang ma yang dag pa'i ngag gi bar du rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi/ dbang lnga/

stobs lnga/ yan lag bdun dang*/ 'phags lam gsum rnams sbyor rgyu yin la/ lhag ma bu ga'i rtsa brgyad la/ 'phags lam bzhi dang yang dag spong ba bzhi/ ro rkyang dbu ma bdud 'bral bzhi/ yang dag pa'i ting 'dzin la sbyar nas/ rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi sogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi gnas sogs sa bcu la sbyar/ 'phags lam phyi ma bzhi dang spong ba bzhi/ 'thung spyod dang nye 'thung spyod yin la/ ting nge 'dzin sa bcu gsum pa la sbyar na/ kun spyod mngon brjod sogs rgyud gzhung rnams dang 'grig rung yin zhing*/ 'di'i sa bcu gsum pa de mthong lam yin pas na/ mthong lam du byang phyogs thams cad thob par bshad pa'i spyi 'gros dang yang 'byor la/ nang gi rtsa khams dag pa'i byang phyogs yin pas/ spyi dang go rim ma mthun kyang skyon med do// //dri ba bcu bzhi pa/ mkhan chen zhi 'tsho/ ye shes zhabs kyi slob ma yin pa 'dra ba zhig rba bzhed las 'byung*/ ye shes zhabs seng bzang gi slob mar lung gis grub na/ seng bzang zhi 'tsho'i slob ma yin pa ji ltar 'grig/ ces pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ zhi 'tsho'i slob ma seng bzang yin pa brgyad stong 'grel chen las gsal/ de'i slob ma ye shes zhabs yin par 'jam dpal zhal lung las 'byung*/ mkhan po bo dhi satwa yang ye shes zhabs kyi slob ma ni nges par yin yod par snang*/ sku tshe ring du bzhugs pa dang*/ mkhan po rang las kyang ye shes zhabs sngags kyi slob dpon che ba yin pa'i phyir/ slob mar 'byung ba ni mi 'gal na'ang*/ dbu ma rgyan mdzad mkhan dang*/ mkhan chen gcig mi gcig brtag dgos so// //dri ba bco lnga pa ni/ hwa shang gi lta ba dngos gzhi ji ltar 'khrul/ spyod pas ma zin pas 'khrul na/ spyod pa'-i phyogs nas dgag rigs kyi/ lta ba 'khrul zhes gsung mi rigs pa 'dra/ zhes pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ spyir ton mun gcig car 'jug pa'i lam zhes bya ba ni/ bod yul du hwa shang mahā ya nas srol phye bar gda'/

rgya nag tu de'i sngon rol du yang ton mun gyi mkhan po chen po nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam byung zhing*/ de dag khungs kyi rtsa ba yang rgya gar la byed par snubs kyi bsam gtan mig sgron las bshad/ de'i lugs kyi go yul gyi lta ba ni/ thal 'gyur ba rnying pa rnams dang mthun/ sgom pa'i lta ba ni yid byed bkag pa kho na la bsngags pa mdzad/ sgom dus so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab mi dgos par ma zad/ de sgom gyi gol sar byas gda'/ spyod pa ni tshul khrims rnam dag bsrung dgos par yang yang bshad pas/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i phyogs la 'khrul ba med/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba dge ba'i las rtsal 'don mi dgos pa dang*/ rjes thob tu snying rje dang dad pa sogs mi 'gog kyang*/ mnyam gzhag gi dus na/ sems can ma dmigs pa tsam snying rje dang*/ sangs rgyas sogs ma dmigs tsam dad pa yin pa sogs su bshad nas/ mdor na dmigs pa med pa la thams cad tshang tshul tsam ma gtogs/ de dag so so'i mtshan nyid can sgom pa de gol sar bzhed pas/ dge ba chos sdud las nyams sam snyam/ 'bras bu yang dmigs pa mtha' dag zad pa las/ gzhan snang du 'gro don 'byung ba tsam du 'chad par snang ste/ des mdzad pa'i mdo sde brgyad cu khungs dang*/ snubs kyi bsam gtan mig sgron na gsal bar snang*/ 'di la ka ma la shī las ni/ so sor rtog pa spangs pas/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab spangs par 'gyur la/ dge ba'i las spangs pas thabs kyang spangs pa'i phyir/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis ka spangs pas sangs rgyas lta ci smos/ thar pa tsam yang mi thob/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab med na/ dmigs pa med pa'ang 'jug par mi nus zhes sogs gsungs pas so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab med pas lta sgom 'khrul la/ dge ba'i las la brtson par ma byas pas spyod pa'ang 'khrul zhes 'gog par snang la/ bstan pa phyi dar la byung ba'i bod rnams la/ 'jog sgom kho na la mos pa dang*/

dpyad sgom kho na la mos pa'i lugs gnyis yod pa las/ phyi ma rnams ni ka ma la shī la'i gsung de la 'khril nas/ las dang po pa'i mi rtog pa sgom pa thams cad nor bar brtsi bar snang la/ snga ma rnams ni 'ga' zhig hwa shang yid byed 'gog pa tsam yin pas/ gsal stong rang rig pa ngos 'dzin pa med pas lta ba nor zer ba dang*/ phyag chen pa kha cig /hwa shang yid byed dang rnam rtog thams cad 'gog pa yin pas nor ba yin la/ kho bo cag rnam rtog gang shar thams cad dgag sgrub spangs blang med par lam du 'khyer ba'i phyir/ ma nor ba yin zhes zer na yang*/ de rnams hwa shang gi lugs gang yin zhib mor ma shes kyang*/ ngan pa gcig yin te 'ong snyam pa dang*/ tshig zur re tsam mthong thos la brten nas tshod dpogs byas par zad de/ rig pa'i rang ngo ngos 'dzin pa dang*/ rnam rtog gang shar thams cad kyang rig tsam de'i rang bzhin du shes par byed pa ni/ ton mun gyi lugs la yang shin tu yod par gsal mod/ spang blang mi byed skad pa'i thabs kyis rtog pa ma spangs rang sar grol bar 'dod pa'i thabs de yang*/ yid byed spong ba'i thabs kho na yin no/ /des na mnyam gzhag tu snying rje sogs kyi snang cha 'gog pa dang*/ thabs kyi cha las g.yel ba'i skyon ni nges par yod cing*/ lta ba sgom pa'i dngos gzhi la yang*/ 'di mdo lugs kho na'i sgom rim yin pas/ dbang gi nyams myong dang*/ bla ma'i byin rlabs dang*/ yi dam lha'i mthu stobs dang*/ rig sngags kyi nus pa dang*/ byed bcings kyi gnad dang*/ rtsa rlung thig le'i rten 'brel sogs las ye shes phebs par 'gyur ba ni med/ mdo lugs nyid la skye ba mang por tshogs bsags pa yang ma yin na/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab sngon du ma song ba'i lta ba skyong lugs 'di/ lta thog tu sleb kyang bogs chung zhing*/ nus pa bul la/ lta ba'i thog tu mi sleb pa'i gol sa'i nyen che ba'i phyir skye bo thams cad la ston pa 'di lag len nor pa yin zhes brjod dgos kyi/
stong phyogs kyi lta

[ ba ] sgom pa'i dngos gzhi rang la 'khrul ba yod par ma mthong ngo*/ /'on kyang lugs de dar na bstan pa'i srol bka' la gnod par gzigs nas/ dus der bsnub par mdzad pa yin la/ ka ma la shī la'i dgag pa de yang*/ lta ba'i skabs der mdo lugs rang rkang la phal che ba'i dbang du mdzad na mi 'gal yang*/ sgra ji bzhin pa la khyab mtha' ni med do/ / snubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis ton mun gyi lugs de dbu ma'i lugs srol rnam dag du bshad la/ snubs de ni rdzogs chen pa thams cad kyis tshad mar byed pa'i slob dpon yin no/ /des na/ phyag rdzogs zhi byed gcod la sogs pa dang*/ ton mun gyi ring lugs la spyod phyogs dang*/ sgom pa gzhan gyi khyad par ni yod srid kyi/ stong nyid kyi rnal 'byor la khyad par med la gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu snying po don gyi bstan par ni/ ton mun yang 'gyur la/ ton mun dar ba'i dgag bya de yang*/ gnas skabs gzhan du gzhan dag la yang 'byung srid pa mthong ngo*/ /kho bos mdo sde brgyad cu khungs mthong ba'i tshe/ 'di'i lta grub kyang bdud kyi las kho na yin no zhes grags che bar snang ba 'di la 'jigs so snyam mo// //dri ba bcu drug pa ni/ 'dod pa la chags bral sngon du song nas/ sngags lam la zhugs pa rnams dang*/ 'chi kha dang bar dor 'tshang rgya ba rnams spyod pa dang nye rgyu la ltos dgos sam/ /zhes dang*/ de la 'phros pa'i dri ba bcu bdun pa ni/ dgos na spyod tshul ji lta bu/ mi dgos na nang gi mngon byang ji ltar tshang zhes pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ 'dod pa la chags bral sngon song dang*/ nyan rang dgra bcom sngags la 'jug pa/ 'tshang rgya ba la spyod pa spyod dgos/ spyod tshul ni de dag sngags la 'jug pa'i sngon rol tu theg chen gyi lam gyi khyad par 'ga' zhig gis rgyud sbyangs nas/ nyon mongs la dbang ba rjes mthun pa tsam thob pa na/ nyon mongs med kyang 'dod pa'i yon tan la brten nas/

bde ba bskyed pa dang*/ khyad par rig ma'i kha sbyor gyi bde ba bsgrub nus pa'ang 'byung ba yin no/ de'i tshe sngags kyi lam la 'jug par byed pa yin gyis/ theg dman gyi chags bral ba rgyud ma sbyangs na/ spyod pa lta ci smos/ dbang dang bskyed rim sgom pa'i skal ba tsam yang med do/ /'dod pa la chags bral gyi so so skye bo chags bral ma nyams pa de ni/ sngags la mos pa skye ba yang dka' la/ ci ste mos na ni 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis 'dod pa'i 'dod chags mngon gyur pa spangs pa de ni slar skye ba la tshegs med do/ /de dag spyir sngags kyi gol sa yin zhing*/ 'on kyang sngags lam la 'jug na tshul de ltar byed do/ /'chi ka bar do'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba dus der 'phags lam thob pa'i ming yin zhing*/ 'chi srid kyi tshe mthong lam thob la/ bar do'i dod la zung 'jug byung ba de la 'chi khar sangs rgyas pa zer zhing*/ 'chi srid kyi tshe drod chen po sogs thob nas/ bar do'i dod du rlung sems tsam gyi sku 'grub de'i rten la lam bsgoms pas/ dbang po rno na skye ba len mi dgos par bar do nyid du 'phags lam 'thob pa yang yod/ yang 'chi khar sku de thob pa rnams 'chi sems kyis bzod pa tsam bgrod nas/ bar dor nges par zung 'jug 'thob pa yin te/ de dag la bar dor 'tshang rgya ba zhes zer te/ 'di dag la skabs de nyid du ni spyod pa dang nye rgyu mi dgos la/ de nas sa rnams rim par bgrod nas 'tshang rgya ba la ni spyod pa dang nye rgyu nges par dgos te/ de dag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spyod pa can yin pa'i phyir/ tshe 'di nyid la zung 'jug 'grub pa rnams dang khyad med do/ /de'i phyir mngon byang lnga 'byung ba la dga' ba'i gnas med do/ /spyir ni 'phags chen nyon mongs shin tu zad pa rnams la'ang*/ gong du bshad pa'i gnas skabs bzhi'i bag chags de ma zad pas/ spyod pa dang nye rgyu dgos kyang dgos la nus pa'ang yin no//

//dri ba bco brgyad pa ni/ rten cing 'brel 'byung sku yin pas/ /ye shes lnga la 'thad pa yin/ /zhes par/ spos khang pas ni rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rigs lnga'i sku mdog phyag rgya rnams/ sbyang gzhi phung po lnga po sbyang bar gsungs/ de ltar na rnal 'byor rgyud du yang bskyed rim 'jog rung bar 'gyur ram gzhan yang*/ des na rnal 'byor rgyud man chad/ snang ba lha ru gsungs pa med/ gsung ba dang 'gal gyis dogs pa ji ltar yin/ zhes pa'o/ /'di la brjod pa/ de la rnal 'byor rgyud man chad du/ srid pa skye 'chi'i rim pa dang mthun pa'i/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs pa bsgoms pas/ rnam par dag par byed tshul gyi sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyor tshul ni med nges la/ de med pa'i phyir/ sbyangs 'bras dang mthun pa'i sgom tshul tsam yod kyang*/ bskyed rim dngos su mi 'gyur/ des na bla med gyi dag dran dang tshul mtshungs pa phung po lnga dag pa mtshon byed tsam du sbyor na ni khungs yod na mi 'gal te/ rigs lnga ye shes lnga mtshon byed yin pa 'dir yang bzhed la/ ye shes bzhi rnam shes brgyad gnas gyur yin pa yo ga 'dir yang yang bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang snang ba lha zhes pa la/ phyis kyi mang po 'dod pa ltar/ da lta'i gzugs phung 'di ka'i steng gi skyon dang dri ma gzhan zhig dag nas/ gzugs phung 'di ka'i rigs rgyud rnam snang du 'gro bar 'dod pa sogs ni bla med la yang mi 'thad la/ 'dir snang ba thams cad lhar sgom par gsungs pa'ang med pas/ de la'ang dgongs shing*/ rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i rnam shes brgyad sogs lam bsgoms pas rnam par dag pa'i tshe/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos nyid rnams/ rgyal ba rigs bzhi yin par bshad kyang*/ dri bcas kyi skabs gdod ma la rigs bzhi rang chas su yod par rgyud 'dir gsal bar ma gsungs pas/ snang ba thams cad lha skur sgom pa'i rnam bzhag mi 'byung ba yin no//

//dri ba bcu dgu pa ni/ yang nyan rang la stong nyid rtogs pa yod pa'i shes byed du/ ji ltar mdud pa'i bye brag gis/ /zhes sogs gzhung du 'dren par mdzad/ de ltar na nyan rang gis chos kyi bdag med rtogs par byed dgos 'dra zhing*/ de tsam rung du chug kyang*/ gzhung des de ltar bstan na/ mdo sde rgyan gyi lugs la/ nyan rang gis chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod par thal ba 'dra'o/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ sdom gsum rab dbye mdzad po nyid slob dpon zla grags kyi bzhed pa la thugs rtsis che bas/ nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod par bzhed srid/ 'on kyang 'di rang la ma nges la/ rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin nyan rang la'ang yod pa dang*/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid sogs stong nyid kyi chos kyi rnam grangs theg dman la yang mang du 'byung zhing*/ 'on kyang de dag gi dngos bstan phal che ba ni/ dngos po rnams rgyu rkyen sna tshogs pa'i rten 'brel las 'byung bas/ byed po la sogs pas stong pa dang*/ rags pa dang*/ rgyun du snang ba rnams 'khrul ba tsam du ston cing*/ chos gang la yang nga bdag gi dngos pos stong pa tsam kho nar snang mod/ de tsam rtogs pa la yang stong nyid rtogs pa'i tha snyad 'jug tu ni rung ste/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa la/ bdag med rtogs pa'i tha snyad thob pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang skabs 'dir ni thabs dang bral bas/ stong nyid tsam rtogs kyang*/ shes bya mtha' dag mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'thob/ yon tan mtha' dag ma thob na sems grol ba gcig pus mi chog ste/ theg dman du ltung ba'i phyir snyam pa thugs la bzhag nas/ rnam snang mngon byang gi lung sogs mang du 'dren par mdzad pa las/ mngon byang gi lung gis gnas tshul la zhugs pa'i ye shes tsam dang*/ bslab gsum cha tshang ba tsam nyan thos la'ang yod pas/ de tsam gyis theg chen gyi lam rdzogs par mi 'gyur ba'i don dang*/

de bzhin du ye shes mi gsal ba dang*/ yon tan ma rdzogs pa sogs lung gzhan dang gzhan gyis bsgrubs nas/ stong nyid rtogs pa tsam du mtshungs kyang*/ ye shes kyis de rtogs tshul la/ khyad chen po yod pa tsam gyi sgrub byed du mdo sde rgyan gyi lung de drangs par snang zhing*/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i sgrub byed du drangs pa min pas/ mdo rgyan gyi lugs la/ theg dman pas bdag med gnyis rtogs yod par 'dod dgos par thal bar mi 'gyur zhing*/ ye shes kyi spyod yul stong nyid gcig pu lta bu zhig shugs la byung kyang der mi 'gyur te/ de skad du yang*/ chos dang bdag med grol ba rnams/ mtshungs spyir rigs ni tha dad phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'dra ste/ rgyal ba'i ye shes kyi yul mtha' dag la/ nyan rang gi ye shes 'jug pa ma yin kyang*/ nyan rang gi ye shes kyi spyod yul thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mnyam par 'jug cing*/ ye shes 'jug tshul yang*/ sangs rgyas la ci tsam mnga' ba rnams thams cad de dag la med kyang*/ de dag la ci tsam yod pa thams cad sangs rgyas la mnga' bas/ nyan rang gnyis la ci tsam yod pa'i ye shes de/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang mtshungs shing*/ de'i yul yang sangs rgyas kyi de dang gcig go /des na 'di skabs kyi don gyi snying po ni/ dkar po chig thub 'gog pa'i don gyi 'phros te/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad pa yang med/ gsang sngags smin grol gyi lam yang spangs/ gzhan yang sbyin sogs thabs kyi cha rnams la/ dgos pa 'ga' zhig gi dbang las/ res 'ga' gus pa ltar byed kyang*/ don gyi zhe nas rtsis chung zhing*/ chos spyod bcu'i rim pa la phal cher g.yel bar snang bas/ khyed rnams sgom pa'i phyag chen de/ stong phyogs kyi sgom tshul kho na'i ngos nas rnam dag gcig yin srid du chug kyang*/ 'phen pa'am/ thabs kyi rgyu tshogs dang bral ba'i phyir/ theg chen 'phags pa'i ye shes rang gzhan gyi don mtha' dag sgrub par nus pa'i yon tan du mas rnam par bkra ba de 'thob par mi 'gyur ro/

/zhes brjod pa na/ des kyang 'di skad zhes/ stong nyid 'di ka ring du goms pa las/ yon tan de dag ngang gis skye bar 'gyur bas/ yon tan gyi rgyu tshogs gzhan de dag ci rigs pa sgrub pa'ang mi 'gal mod kyi/ nges par bsten dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /zhes zer na/ de ltar yang ma yin te/ mtshan 'dzin las grol ba dang*/ sna tshogs pa'i yon tan 'grub pa yang rgyu'i rab dbye tha dad las 'byung bas/ stong nyid sgom pa tsam nyon mongs dang mtshan 'dzin las grol ba'i rgyu yin kyang*/ thabs dang bral na gzhan don sgrub nus pa'i yon tan mi 'grub ste/ thabs rgya che chung las/ yon tan rgya che chung 'byung bas so/ /de ltar yang*/ de bzhin 'phen pa'i dbang gis ni grol ba'i ye shes bkra mi bkra/ zhes pa'i lung las so/ /zhes pa'i don yin no/ /gzhan yang*/ spyir ni nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa med pa nyid lung rigs rnam dag gis grub ste/ yod par 'dod pa rnams kyi khungs su 'dren pa'i lung rnams de'i khungs su mi 'gyur zhing*/ rigs pa rnams kyang ma nges la/ de la ldog phyogs gnod byed kyi lung dang rigs pa yang mang du yod pa'i phyir ro// //dri ba nyi shu pa ni/ rdzogs rim pa'i drod dang sngags bla med kyi sbyor lam drod la khyad yod dam med/ /zhe sa pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ kho bo'i rang lugs la ni khyad med de/ lam lnga bstan pa zhes bya ba'i gzhung dang*/ de'i don bsdus kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i phyir rdzogs rim pa'i drod gsum dang*/ sbyor lam drod gsum rim can du sbyor zhing*/ drod chung ngu ni lam gyi snang ba'i ye shes dang lam gyi dga' ba/ 'bring po ni lam gyi mched pa dang mchog dga'/ chen po ni lam gyi thob pa rigs gnyis dang*/ dga' ba phyi ma gnyis kyi rtogs pa'o/ /ljon shing la sogs pa'i dgongs pa ni/ drod chung ngu sbyor lam drod kyi sbyor ba dang*/ 'bring po sbyor lam drod dngos dang*/

chen po sbyor lam drod kyi rjes yin pas/ rtse mo sogs la ngos 'dzin mdzad cing*/ de gsum sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi ye shes skye ba'i snga ltas yin pa dang*/ rdzogs rim pa'i drod la sbyor lam drod kyi khyab mtha' mi 'cha' yang*/ de'i chung 'bring gnyis dang gcig pa la dgongs nas de gnyis gcig pa'i tha snyad kyang mdzad de/ lugs 'di yang rgyud gzhung gi don dang mthun shas che ba re legs su snang bas/ rnam grangs su khas blangs bar bya'o// //dri ba nyer gcig pa ni/ spyod pa'i skabs kyi brtan pa thob pa dang*/ brtan pa chen po thob pa zhes pa gnyis kyi/ khyad par 'jog byed ji lta bu dgos/ zhes pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ dang po rang gi khyim du sgom/ /brtan pa thob nas dur khrod sogs/ /brtan pa chen po thob nas ni/ /zhes pa'i gzhung la 'dri ba yin na ni/ rim pa gnyis kyi ye shes brtan cing*/ phyi'i rkyen phan gnod bde sdug sna tshogs kyis/ nyams myong mi 'grib par 'phel pa'i grogs byed pa tsam la brtan pa thob pa zhes bya/ de nas kun 'dar gsangs te spyod pa sogs byed du rung*/ de'i steng du dngos grub dang nus pa'i khyad par mang po thob nas gzhan don tshar gcod rjes 'dzin la rang dbang thob pa de'i tshe brtan pa chen po thob pa zhes bya ba yin te/ de nas kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa khyad par can spyod pa yin no/ /yang spyi ldog nas 'dri ba yin na/ gang zag rnam pa bzhi'i nang gi ye shes la dbang ba'i gang zag la/ brtan pa thob pa dang*/ ye shes la ches dbang ba'i gang zag la/ brtan pa chen po thob pa zhes bya ba yin pas/ brtan pa thob pa dang*/ brtan pa chen po thob pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang*/ de dag la rtsi ba yin no// //dri ba nyer gnyis pa ni/ bo dong paṇa chen gyi bzhed pa la/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi skabs 'ga' zhig tu gnyis sbyor gyi chags pa lam du byed pa yod pa ltar bur snang na'ang*/

spyi khyab tu 'dod chags rigs bzhi dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi sbyor ba'i chos skad dang ni mi 'grig pa 'dra/ ji ltar 'thad ces pa ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ spyir slob dpon kun dga' snying pos sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yo gar bkral ba dang*/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud dang*/ gsang ba brgyan bkod dang*/ gsang ba nor bu thig le ste rgyud gsum po 'di rnal 'byor rgyud yin par bod la grags pa dang*/ rdo rje snying rgyan gyi 'grel par bzhi pa bshes gnyen zhes bya bas mdzad pa der yang yo gar bkral snang ba dang*/ rgyud rjes ma gsum po de chos rje sa paṇa gyis bsgyur zhing*/ rdo rje snying rgyan gyi 'gyur 'phro lus pa spang los 'gyur bas bas shing*/ rgyud de'i 'grel pa yang bu ston chen pos bsgyur ba yin la/ rgyud gsum po'i 'gyur byang na yang yo ga'i rgyud yin par bshad de ltar dpyad pa med par bod la grags che ba dang bstun te/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig yo ga'i ma rgyud du bzhed pa'ang snang*/ bo dong pa ni rgyud sde bzhi'i rnal 'byor rgyud la'ang nang tshan du phye na/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rjes su rnal 'byor dang shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud de bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ de nyid bsdus pa dang*/ dpal mchog dang po sogs dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang*/ gsum pa ni/ snying rgyan gsang rgyan gnyis dang*/ bzhi pa ni nor thig yin no zhes gsung zhing*/ de'i phyi ma gsum la/ yid kyis bsgoms pa'i rig ma la bsten nas gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba lam byed tsam ni/ dmigs pa la gsal snang skyes pa'i gang zag la yod par bzhed cing*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i yan lag tu brtan pa cher thob pa'i gang zag gis dngos kyi rig ma la brten pa yang yod do zhes bzhed do/ /'on kyang 'thad pa'i phyogs ni/ gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud rdo rje snying rgyan las/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/

/'dod chags thabs chen po yi rgyud/ /gang gis legs par shes na ni/ /tshe 'dir dngos grub sbyin par bshad/ /gsang ba 'dus pa stong phrag gcig /rdo rje 'phreng ba 'bum phrag gsum/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa'i skabs na/ snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul stong dang brgya/ /rdo rje gsang rgyan stong phrag gcig /ces pa dang*/ rdo rje snying rgyan stong phrag lnga/ /zhes pa dang*/ nor bu gsang thig 'bum phrag gcig /ces gsungs shing thams cad kyi 'jug na/ 'di ni gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa yi/ /rgyud kyi dbye ba bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ gsang 'dus sogs dang rgyud sde mtho dman 'dra bar bstan pa dang*/ tshe 'di kho na la dngos grub ster ba dang*/ thabs rgyud chen po yin par bshad pa dang*/ 'dod chags rigs bzhi'i nang gi gnyis sbyor gtso bor lam byed yin par bshad pas/ rgyud de rnams ni rgyud sde bzhi'i zlas phye ba'i tshe nges par bla med yin dgos la/ de dag las sgyu drwa ni/ lha sngags sogs thams cad kyang gsang 'dus dang mthun shas che zhing*/ de'i phyir bod phal cher yang bla med du 'dod la/ kun snying gis yo gar bkral yang de tsam gyis der mi 'gyur te/ gsang 'dus bzhin no/ /rgyud 'dir phyi'i de nyid gtso bor ston pas/ lag pa'i phyag rgya 'ching ba mang du gsung mod/ de tsam gyis kyang bla med min par mi 'gyur te/ gdan bzhi bzhin no/ /snying rgyan sogs su lha sngags kyi rim pa dpal mchog sogs dang mthun shas che yang rgyu mtshan snga ma rnams kyis bla med yin pa mi 'gal zhing*/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rang lam la yang*/ de nyid bsdus pa sogs kyi tshig zur mang po las/ lha'i rnal 'byor sogs kyi de kho na nyid la gnas bzhin du/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod spyi dang khyad par rnams bsten yang nyes pas gos par mi 'gyur ba sogs mang du gsungs pas/ rnal 'byor la dbang ba rnams la gnyis sbyor bsten kyang nyes pas gos par mi 'gyur ba ni yin la/

de nyid lam gyi yan lag tu bstan pa yang srid mod kyi/ rgyud 'di'i 'dod chags lam byed kyi gtso bo lag bcang phan chod nyid yin pas/ gnyis sbyor gtso bor ston pa min pa gcig nges par dgos so/ /des na snying rgyan sogs gsum ngo bo bla med du bsdu ba yin kyang*/ rgyud sde gnyis po'i mtshams sbyor ba tsam yin par mngon zhing*/ dper na/ ngan song sbyong rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud dang mthun shas che ba'i spyod rgyud yin pa bzhin no/ /skabs 'dir nges par rtogs dgos pa la/ bdag nyid lha'i bsnyen pa dang ldan pa'i lam ston phyin chad du/ 'dod pa'i yon tan spyi tsam la ci dgar spyad pas kyang nyes pas mi gos shing*/ bsod nams kyi rgyur 'gyur bar ston pa ni nges par 'byung ba chos nyid yin la/ spyir na gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi car du/ 'dod yon lam byed dang*/ chags pa lam byed dang*/ khyad par gyis kyang rig ma'i 'dod chags lam byed gsungs pa yin pas/ sngags rgyud sde bzhi car la chags lam zhes spyir bstan pa yin no/ /de yang ji ltar zhe na bya ba'i rgyud du/ mdun bskyed kyi lha lta ba'i rjes chags kyi rnam pa can la sgrub pa pos yid kyis dmigs pa'i rig ma'i rjes chags tsam lam du byed pa mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i lam du nges par gsungs pa yin zhing las tshogs dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa tsam la ni/ de lta bu'i rjes chags mi dgos pas/ bya rgyud kyi dngos grub sgrub tshul mtha' dag la ni dgos pa ma yin no/ /gzhan yang sgrub pa po'i sems sbyang ba'i phyir mi yul gyi 'dod pa'i longs spyod la ci dgar spyod pa bkag kyang lha'i ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa thob nas/ rig sngags kyi nus pa yang grub pa na/ de kho na nyid la dmigs pa'i ting 'dzin ni brtan por 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe lha rdzas kyi 'dod yon lnga dang*/ ting 'dzin gyi spyod yul gyi gzugs la sogs pa 'dod pa'i longs spyod mtha' yas pa 'byung zhing*/

de dag la mngon par chags pa lam du byed do/ /dka' thub dang gtsang sbra bshad pa ni/ gnas skabs de lta bu ma thob pa'i las dang po pa'i skabs su/ ye shes kyi lha'i 'khor du gtogs pa 'jig rten pa'i lha gtsang

: ris rnams （《dzaṃ》 sbras rtag tu ） mgu bar bya ba'i don yin gyis/ lam gyi ngos gzhi'i cha lag tu dgos pa yang min zhing*/ dmigs gsal 'ga' zhig tu gtan nas mi dgos pa yang yod de/ /khro bo stobs po che sgrub pa dang*/ srin po la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i lha 'chol pa 'ga' zhig la yang ngo*/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi : spyod yul gyi gzugs sogs la/ （《dzaṃ》 don du 'gyur rung la dgongs pas/ ） pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam du 'di ni nges par chags pa dang bral bar byed la/ 'dir ni nges par chags par byas te/ de lam du byed pa yin no/ /bya rgyud du 'byung ba 'di dag ni/ rgyud sde gong ma gsum gyi lam la yar ldan du yod cing*/ des gzhan yang rigs 'gre'o/ /spyod rgyud du ni phal cher de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ bdag bskyed lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i phyir ting nge 'dzin gyi grogs su 'gyur na/ las dang po pas kyang gzugs sgra sogs mi'i 'dod yon la yang bkag bya chung zhing*/ lha yab yum rgaud pa'i bde ba lam byed ni/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa ma zad/ bdag bskyed la brten nas kyang yod pas snga ma las ches khyad zhugs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du/ rnal 'byor rgyud du/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la dmigs pa'i rjes chags gtso mi che zhing bdag bskyed la lta sgom gnyis yan lag tu yod cing*/ 'khyud pa dang lag bcang gnyis kyi chags pa lam byed ni/ gtso bor yid kyi rig ma la bsten nas sgrub pa yin zhing*/ ting 'dzin la sems brtan pa thob nas ni de gnyis dngos kyi rig mas kyang sgrub par byed do/ /de dag ni rgyud sde 'di nyid kyi rang lugs la nges par sgrub dgos la/ gnyis sbyor ni cung zad lam du 'gyur ba srid kyang nges par dgos pa ma yin zhing*/ gtso bor bstan pa yang ma yin no/ /bla med la ni grags che bas rgyas par bshad mi dgos kyang bskyed rim gyi skabs su dngos dang*/

ye shes kyi rig ma'i chags pa lam du byed pa tsam yin la/ rdzogs rim gyi rjes chags ni/ rlung sems dbu ma'i thig le ra'i thim par byed pa'i phyir dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba sgrub pa'i phyir du yin la/ bskyed rim pa spyod pa dang 'brel na/ lha mnyes pa'i don dang*/ rdzogs rim pa spyod pa dang 'brel na/ bde sdug sogs gnyis snang can gyi yul thams cad lhan skyes kyi bde bar bsre ba'i phyir yin te/ de ltar so sor nges shing dbang dus kyi rjes chags ni de dag las ma nges pa ci rigs par sbyar ro// //dri ba nyer gsum pa ni/ theg dman gyi sde snod las/ rgyal bu don grub kyi rten la sangs rgyas par bshad pa drang don dang*/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sder/ dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas sangs rgyas zin par bshad pa nges don yin par grags na'ang*/ mi g.yo ba bla med kyi rgyud las pho brang du/ btsun mo'i 'khor dang lhan cig nye rgyu'i rim pas sangs rgyas thob par gsungs na/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las/ gsang sngags bla med kyi lung dbang btsan par bya dgos 'dra na/ rgyal bu don grub kyi rten la/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang gsar du thob par mi 'gyur ram zhes pa ste/ de la brjod pa/ nyan thos kyi theg pa las/ rgyal bu don grub bdud btul zin pa'i dus yan chod so so skye bo yin pa rdo rje'i gdan du sangs rgyas gsar du brnyes par bshad pa dang*/ der ma zad rgya che rol pa sogs theg chen gyi mdo sder yang*/ sa bcu brnyes pa'i 'phags par bshad pa tsam ma gtogs rgyal bu don grub gyi rten la/ rdo rje'i gdan du sangs rgyas gsar thob yin pa sogs theg dman dang 'dra ba ni drang don yin la/ mdo sde gzhan mang por/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi sngon rol nas sangs rgyas pa yin par bshad pa ni nges don no/ /de bzhin du sngags kyi theg par yang sna tshogs gsungs te/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/

rgya che rol pa sogs dang mthun par gsungs shing*/ bya spyod gzhan las kyang de dang mthun pa dang*/ thog ma med pa'i dus can du bshad pa dang*/ rnam snang gi zhing khams gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan par sangs rgyas nas/ zhing 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa sogs sna tshogs snang zhing*/ de nyid bsdus pa sogs kyi dngos bstan la yang*/ byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pa yid kyi lus can sa bcu'i mthar phyin pa de/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam kho nas sangs rgya bar bzhed pa la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi bskul nas/ sngags kyi lam la bcug ste/ mngon byang lnga'i gdams ngag bstan te/ sangs rgyas par bshad la/ 'di'i rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi ting nge 'dzin mdo lam de yang*/ theg dman dang chos skad go bstun nas/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' yin par bshad do/ /bla med la yang*/ rim lnga dang grol thig sogs las/ de nyid bsdus pa nas gsungs pa dang mthun rung las/ nye rgyu'i dbang bskur te/ mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pas phyi nang gi mngon byang gnyis la brten nas sangs rgyas brnyes par bshad de/ de dag kyang 'o skol gyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das la sbyar ba ni/ drang don gyi dbang du byas la/ spyir rim pa de lta bu'i sangs rgyas gsar du thob pa yod med la dpyod na ni/ de dag las ci rigs pa ni yod do/ /de bzhin du mi g.yo ba bla med kyi rgyud las khyim du gzhugs pa'i tshe/ nye rgyu'i spyod pa la brten nas sangs rgyas brnyes pa yin kyang chags bral gyi gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir rab tu byung nas sangs rgyas brnyes par bstan pa yin no/ /zhes bshad pa dang*/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud las kyang*/ khyim du bzhugs pa'i spros bcas kyi spyod pa dang*/ rab tu byung nas kun tu rgyu rnams dang lhan cig gshegs pa'i tshe/ zhing rnams su kun 'dar kyi spyod pa dang nai rañja na'i 'gram du lo drug shin tu spros med dang*/

'o thug gsol ba phan chad nas nye rgyu'i spyod par bshad pa'ang yod pas de 'dra'i rigs rnams kyang*/ spyir mthar thug gi 'bras bu sgrub pa la bla na med pa'i sngags kyi theg pa'i lam dgos so/ /gang zag gcig gsar du sangs rgya ba'i tshe 'di lta bu zhig spyod dgos so zhes ston pa'ang yin la/ 'o skol gyi ston pa nyid la sbyar na/ de yang tshul ston yin no/ /des na 'di skad ces bya ste/ re zhig nyan thos kyi theg pa nas/ sngags bla med kyi bar la/ 'o skol gyi ston pa mngon par sangs rgyas tshul yang mi 'dra ba mang zhing*/ gang zag gcig mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul la yang*/ 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba mang na/ de dag phal cher ba ni tshul ston dang*/ drang don yin la/ mi 'dra ba du ma 'byung ba ni sems can so so'i snang ngo dang bstun pa yin no/ /de la theg dman gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya rnams la ni/ byang chub snying por gshegs pa yan chod so so skye bo dang*/ de nas rdo rje'i gdan du theg dman rang du bshad pa'i lam bsgoms pas/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang brnyes par mthong zhing*/ theg chen mdo lugs kyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya so so skye bo rnams kyi snang ngor/ so so skye bo'i sa spangs nas ni/ bskal pa grangs med gnyis lon kyang*/ byang chub snying por gshegs kyi bar ni sangs rgyas ma yin par snang zhing*/ dga' ldan du gnas pa skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang*/ rgyal bu don grub kyang srid pa tha ma pa dang 'dra ba'i byang chub sems dpar snang zhing*/ de nas rdo rje'i gdan du mdo lam la brten nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par mthong ba yin la/ 'og min gyi zhing khams blta bar mi nus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa mdo lam pas kyang rang nyid kyis mthong tshul de ka dang phyogs mtshungs la/ 'on kyang zhing mtha' yas pa na gcig car de lta bu'i mdzad pa ston pa dang*/ ma nges pa'i sprul pa sna tshogs pa ston pa yang shes so/

/sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba 'og tu 'chad par ni/ sde snod kyi chos la dmigs pa'i tshul dang*/ dad pa'i stobs kyis shes pa yin gyi/ rang gi mthong tshul gyis shes pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin du sngags kyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya rnams la yang : sar [ sbyar ] te/ bya spyod kyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya so so skye bo la phal cher mdo dang 'dra la/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya so so skye bo la/ de nyid bsdus pa nas bshad pa ltar dang*/ bla med kyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya la'ang*/ rim lnga zhal lung sogs las bshad pa dang*/ gtum po khro bo'i rgyud dang*/ sgrol ma 'byung ba sogs las bshad pa ltar ci rigs par snang ba yin te/ gdul bya de dang de las de'i snang ngo na de ltar snang zhing snang ba ltar kun rdzob tu don byed nus pa yin pas/ gsung rab de dang de bzhin du gsungs pa yin no/ /nges pa'i don du ni 'o skol gyi ston pa sangs rgyas pa'i dus gang yin ngos 'dzin pa dka' yang*/ spyir sangs rgyas thams cad 'tshang rgya lugs gcig cing*/ de yang 'di ltar yin te/ tshogs sbyor gyi lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ma dag pa'i zhing 'di rnams su 'gro ba rigs drug rnams dang snang ba thun mong du spyod pa shas che la/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar du ni/ bde ba can dang mngon dga' la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi smon lam 'dzom pa las byung ba'i zhing khams de rnams su gtso bor spyod cing*/ ma dag pa'i zhing 'di rnams su'ang snang ba gzhan du gyur pa'i tshul gyis 'ong zhing*/ smon lam gyi lus yongs su blangs nas spyod par ni byed do/ /brgyad pa dang*/ dgu pa la gtso bor 'og min dang rjes su mthun pa'i zhing khams su 'jug cing*/ gong du bshad pa'i dag pa'i zhing khams de thams cad du ting 'dzin gyi skye bas spyod cing rang snang la ni ma dag pa'i zhing 'di mi snang bas 'dir spyod rgyu med mod/

gdul bya gzhan snang la/ smon lam gyi stobs kyis zhing 'di rnams su 'gro ba'i don byed do/ /sa bcu pa yang phal cher de dang 'dra ba las/ rang snang la ni 'og min gyi zhing kho nar spyod par byed la/ dag pa dang ma dag pa'i zhing khams gzhan de gnyis su/ gzhan snang smon lam gyi stobs kyis 'gro ba'i don la 'jug pa yin no/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na/ dngos su sangs rgya ba'i tshul yin phyin chad/ 'og min gyi zhing khams der/ sa bcu'i tha mar rgyun mtha'i ye shes bskyed nas/ de'i skad cig gnyis par sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan gyi sangs rgyas su 'gyur zhing*/ 'og min gyi zhing khams de la'ang sngar sa bcu ba'i dus na gnyis snang phra mo zhig gis g.yogs shing khyab pa de/ dus der sangs nas gnyis med kyi ye shes kho na snang ngo*/ /de nas smon lam kyi stobs kyis phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas pa rnams su/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad 'byung ba yin pas/ sangs rgyas pa phan chad sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa las byung ba nges pa zhig yin na/ dga' ldan na bzhugs pa nas brtsams sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa kho nar nges la/ yang dag pa gcig tu na/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba la sangs rgyas su sprul nas mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston par bshad pas/ de 'dra'i rigs yin na ni mdzad pa bcu gnyis gar yang byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa yin par 'gyur ba 'dra'o snyams pa dpyod ldan la 'byung srid na'ang*/ 'di yang mthar gtugs pa na/ sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs kyi stobs kho nas byed pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa nyid yin zhing*/ spyir na bdud btul ba yan chad byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ mdzad pa phyi ma gsum sangs rgyas kyi mdzad par byed pa tshul ston la de ltar yin zhes brjod dgos kyi/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi phrugs gcig gi dngos gnas la dbye ba de 'dra mi srid do/ /sangs rgyas thob tshul nges don 'di ni/

mdo sngags gnyis kar gyi thun mong yin pas/ rnam pa thams cad du khas blang bya yin la/ sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa ni/ rgyun mtha' las nye rgyu'i dbang bskur ba la brten nas/ skye ba dang sku yang yan lag bdun ldan yin pa dang*/ spang bya yang 'gyur bde'i bag chags phra mo spangs pa dang*/ 'khor dang zhing khams kyang zab mo'i dkyil 'khor yin par 'chad pa rnams gzhan med cing*/ de dag dngos po'i gnas tshul la yang zhugs pa yin no/ /des na/ dngos gnas la de bzhin gshegs pa 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sangs rgyas so zhes zer ba ni/ lhas byin gyi rmi lam gyi ri'i rtse mor mchod bzhin gnyid sad pa rnams khang bzang 'debs par byed do zhes zer ba dang mtshungs shing*/ mdor na ma dag pa'i snang ba 'di rnams dngos gnas la yod ma myong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ bag chags shin tu srabs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dag pa ba la yang mi snang na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la lta smos kyang ci dgos/ yod pa yang ma yin zhing snang ba yang med pa der su zhig sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ gzhan yang 'di rnams dang 'brel ba 'di ltar go dgos te/ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing la yang*/ rjes mthun pa sa brgyad dgu la snang ba dang*/ cung zad bsgribs pa'i zhing khams sa bcu pa la snang ba dang*/ shin tu dag pa'i zhing khams sangs rgyas kho na la snang ba ste/ dngos btags ma phye na gsum yod la/ de gsum la rim par btags pa ba dang*/ tsam po dang*/ khyad par can gsum du brda' sbyar na rung ngo*/ /de la longs sku'i zhing khams zhes bya zhing*/ lang gshegs las gsungs pa'i/ gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og min du/ /'dod chags bral khyod 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gzugs khams yin pa dang*/ gtsang ma'i gnas dag spangs pa yi/ /'og min gnas mchog nyams dga' bar/ /zhes gnas gtsang ma'i 'og min ma yin par yang bshad pa lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po'i gnas de yin la/ der 'tshang rgya tshul bshad pa 'di yang*/
